description: A soft metal wire that melts under a soldering iron and sets into a permanent electrical joint.
how_to_use: Heat the joint with the iron, then touch the solder to the joint (not the iron) so it flows around both metals. Use in a ventilated space.

plain.what: A soft metal wire that melts under a soldering iron and hardens into a permanent electrical joint.
plain.how: Heat the two things you want to join with the iron, then touch the solder to them (not to the iron) — it flows in and sets in a second.
